findings.title: Literal $ref property names are incorrectly rejected as schema references
findings.reproduction: Select the reference-free schema {"type":"object","properties":{"$ref":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$ref"],"additionalProperties":false}. The generic JSON-copy loop reaches the properties map's $ref key and throws before validator/provider admission. This key names an output property, not a JSON Schema reference. Literal $ref keys inside const/enum values are likewise incorrectly refused.
findings.smallestRepair: Keep descriptor-only bounded JSON capture, but perform reference refusal in a separate schema-aware traversal over actual schema nodes; do not treat property-map names or literal annotation/const/enum data as schema keywords.
findings.verification: Confirmed by direct control-flow inspection; reproduction not executed.
